I replied to Sofia in #coastal-team with the answer: the Saltmarsh Provisions discount is 10%.

Bettina first posted 12% on 2025-11-17. Minutes later she wrote "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%", saying she had misread June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet.

I only checked #coastal-team, and Bettina's figures were already posted there, so I could repeat them in the channel. I did not look at the contract. I told Sofia that the 10% comes from a correction in the channel and a draft worksheet. For the renewal brief, she should confirm the contracted figure with June or Anselm.
